notes: service_supervision::Supervisor (crates/susi-daemon/src/service_supervision.rs) is now the single in-process supervisor: every long-lived daemon worker spawns through it — signal-handler, pheromone-evaporator, gemi-http, gmcp-http, gmcp-http-alias, a2a-udp-discovery, a2a-http, pulse-worker, leaf-service-monitor, stun-discovery, os-tick, gossip-recv, ambient-indexer, cell-watcher, runtime-admin, capability-rediscovery — and every helper is a supervised one-shot (cell spawners, child reapers, mcp-auto-link, swarm-scout-kick). Zero bare thread::spawn/thread::Builder remains in production susi-daemon code (mastery source scan). Health: thread-exit plus heartbeat() per loop pass and a shared WatchdogManager cell per worker (attach_watchdog back-fills; dead-cell findings mark hung); a hung worker is reported, never cloned. Bounded restart through per-worker factories (listeners try_clone per respawn), every restart/panic/down logged to the shared supervisor.log via slog. One status surface: supervision.json persisted each round + folded into os_planes/susi os. The daemon process itself revives through ensure_daemon_running (detect dead pid -> respawn) and its systemd cgroup; the primary watcher keeps its heartbeat file.
